blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — A 27-year-old motorcycle driver was killed while his 21-year-old passenger was injured in a road crash in Barangay Manangat, Caoayan town, in this province on Sunday, Oct. 18. Police said the two victims, both residents of Barangay Fuerte in Caoayan, were riding a white-and-blue Honda Click 125 motorcycle along the provincial road when they hit an electrical post. Both were rushed to the Ilocos Sur Provincial Hospital–Gabriela Silang in Tamag, Vigan City, for medical treatment.
